user.title: Set up Dynalogic
user.description: Dynalogic needs no account. Every lookup takes an order number plus the delivery postcode, so enter the postcode you have parcels delivered to — it becomes the default for every parcel you add. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `dynalogic.track_parcel` action.

data_description.postal_code: The postcode parcels are delivered to, e.g. 1012AB (NL) or 1000 (BE).

error.invalid_postcode: That is not a Dutch or Belgian postcode. Use four digits, plus two letters for a Dutch postcode, e.g. 1012AB or 1000.

data_description.add: Enter the Dynalogic order number to start tracking it. You find it in the shipping confirmation or the tracking mail — MediaMarkt, Samsung, Nespresso and Menken deliveries all run on Dynalogic too.
data_description.postal_code: Only needed when this parcel goes to a different address than the one you set up. Leave empty to use it.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a Dynalogic order number.
error.invalid_postcode: That is not a Dutch or Belgian postcode. Use four digits, plus two letters for a Dutch postcode, e.g. 1012AB or 1000.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.
error.parcel_not_found: Dynalogic does not know that order number with this postcode. Check both — the postcode must be the one the parcel is being delivered to.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Dynalogic. Try again in a moment.
